description: How much stabilizer (cyanuric acid, CYA) raises your pool to a target level, or how much water to drain and refill to lower it. Formula: Raise: stabilizer (oz) = (target − current) ÷ 10 × gallons ÷ 10,000 × 13. Lower (dilution): share to drain = (current − target) ÷ (current − fill water); gallons = share × pool volume.

fill_water_ppm.description: Cyanuric acid in your fill water (ppm); default 0

target_ppm.description: Target cyanuric acid (from your pool builder or test kit guide) (ppm); default 40

name: calc_pool_stabilizer
title: Pool Stabilizer (Cyanuric Acid) Calculator: How Much to Add or Drain
